IEAGHG (2017). Techno-Economic Evaluation of SMR Based Standalone (Merchant) Hydrogen Plant with CCS. Technical Report 2017-02, February 2017. IEA Greenhouse Gas R&D Programme, Cheltenham, UK. Prepared by Amec Foster Wheeler (Collodi, G., Azzaro, G., Ferrari, N.) and IEAGHG.

Targeted pass over the 286-page report (IEAGHG overview PDF p.2-24, Amec Foster Wheeler main report Sect. 2-8, Reference Document). Locators are PDF page numbers (the main report counts Sheet n of 112). Six cases of one greenfield merchant plant, 100,000 Nm3/h H2, The Netherlands, 4Q-2014 EUR: Base (no capture), 1A MDEA on shifted syngas, 1B as 1A with H2-rich burners, 2A MDEA on PSA tail gas, 2B cryogenic+membrane on tail gas, 3 MEA on flue gas. Loaded per case: host-plant rows (NG feed+fuel, efficiency, CO2 emitted, share to capture, host capex = hydrogen plant + power island + utilities/BoP from the case cost sheets, whole-plant opex, LCOH, CAC), capture-plant rows (capex, CO2 captured, electricity; LP steam in flows) and CO2 compression/dehydration rows (1A, 1B, 2A, 3; for 2B compression is inside the capture plant). Opex is NOT split between host and capture in the source: it is on the host rows with INCLUDES CAPTURE. Whole-case TPC/TCR are in other-values. Basis per Nm3 of H2 (product 10.789 MJ LHV/Nm3 = 299.70 MW / 100,000 Nm3/h, for GJ conversion). All energy LHV; all costs total plant cost (TPC) at 4Q-2014 EUR, AACE Class 4 +35/-15%. Not loaded: stream tables, equipment lists, sensitivities, TCR breakdown (Annex III). Traps: Case 2A utility table lists 1.8 t/h of a second steam stream beside 66.9 t/h LP steam (not interpreted); overview capture rates are rounded to 0.1% (main report prints 55.71, 66.90, 54.07, 53.28, 90.00).
